title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W8 late-response guard lacks the route check — a stale ApiReturnedRefcheckAction still toasts on an unrelated page
location: client/src/client.gleam:3522-3559 (handler); client/src/client.gleam:6584-6596 (find_refcheck_call); client/src/client.gleam:561-562,651 (detail persists on non-detail navigation)
detail: Navigating detail->non-detail page leaves application_detail Success, so the id-match guard finds the old call and a stale response still toasts (success or error) on an unrelated page; only the refetch is route-guarded.
recommended_fix: Add a route guard to ApiReturnedRefcheckAction: match model.route for the same ApplicationDetail(vid, aid) that fired the action (or route-unchanged check) before toasting; drop silently otherwise. Extend the late-response test to cover detail->dashboard navigation.
